{{MultipleIssues|citation|expand|image}}
'''Homing proton torpedoes''', also known as '''seeker proton torpedoes''', were [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] that possessed lock-on capability.
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike}}
During [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron's]] [[Defense of Ralltiir|evacuation]] of pro-Rebel scientists from [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], Luke Skywalker, after hijacking an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] and while escorting the scientists, briefly turned into a corner and procured several homing proton torpedoes.
{{Endgame}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)}}
While [[Escape from Fest|rescuing a Rebel unit]] on the planet [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], Rogue Squadron, while demolishing the Imperial Research Facility on Fest, did a detour to retrieve seeker proton torpedoes in close proximity to the research facility proper.

Later, during Rogue Squadron's [[Raid on Sullust]], Rogue Squadron destroyed a bunker in close proximity to both a transmitter and a TIE landing pad, uncovering another set of seeker proton torpedoes.
{{Endgame}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader}}
During the [[Battle of Kothlis]]'s ground battle, Rogue Leader, Wedge Antilles, briefly diverted from the battle to recover a case of homing proton torpedoes that he spotted of what remained of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer ''Motivator''{{'s}} bridge tower.
{{Endgame}}
